# Bench Accounting

> > Bench Accounting provides online bookkeeping services, tax filing, and financial tools for small businesses and entrepreneurs.

Bench offers automated bookkeeping with human expert support, integrating with platforms like Square and Stripe. The site features educational content on accounting fundamentals, tax compliance (including IRS procedures and GAAP standards), business metrics, and financial calculators to help small business owners manage their finances.

## Key Topics

- Bookkeeping services
- Tax filing and compliance
- IRS notices and procedures
- GAAP accounting standards
- Small business finances
- Financial statements
- Business metrics and KPIs
- Tax liability and debt resolution
- Accounting automation
- Square and Stripe integrations
- Revenue and profit analysis
- Year-over-year growth tracking
- CP504 notices
- Debt-to-equity ratios
- Entrepreneur resources

## Core Services & Integrations

- [Streamline your bookkeeping with Square & Bench](https://www.bench.co/integrations/square): Square integration for automated bookkeeping and tax filing with Bench

## Accounting Fundamentals & Guides

- [A Beginner's Guide to The Accounting Cycle](https://www.bench.co/blog/accounting/accounting-cycle): Six-step accounting cycle guide following GAAP and FASB standards
- [Revenue vs. Profit: The Difference and When They Matter](https://www.bench.co/blog/accounting/revenue-vs-profit): Explains revenue vs profit metrics and their impact on business outcomes
- [How to Calculate and Use Year-Over-Year (YOY) Growth](https://www.bench.co/blog/accounting/yoy-growth-formula): YOY growth formula calculation guide for tracking business performance
- [How the Bench App Helps You Assess the Health of Your Business](https://www.bench.co/blog/accounting/assess-business-health-bench-app): Using Bench app with Stripe integration for financial health tracking

## Tax Tips & IRS Compliance

- [Tax Liability: What It Is and How to Calculate It](https://www.bench.co/blog/tax-tips/calculate-tax-liability): Small business tax liability calculation guide including Form 1040
- [How Does the IRS Collect Unpaid Taxes?](https://www.bench.co/blog/tax-tips/collect-unpaid-taxes): IRS collection methods: levies, liens, and payment plan options
- [Understanding Your CP504: A Breakdown](https://www.bench.co/blog/tax-tips/cp504): CP504 IRS notice guide covering tax debt resolution and levy prevention

## Financial Tools & Calculators

- [Debt to Equity Ratio Calculator](https://www.bench.co/tools/debt-to-equity-ratio-calculator): Calculator tool to assess financial leverage and debt-to-equity ratios

## Company News & Announcements

- [Bench Launches New Class with Skillshare](https://www.bench.co/blog/bench-news/bench-skillshare-class): Bench-Skillshare partnership for entrepreneur accounting education
- [National Day for Truth and Reconciliation](https://www.bench.co/blog/bench-news/dei-national-day-of-truth-and-reconciliation-2021): Bench's commitment to Truth & Reconciliation via FNTC partnership
